lines.x: Doctor, let me help!

Doctor! You've been glued to that chair forever, and that's totally not good for you. Time for a quick workout session with me—stretch those muscles, replenish your energy. Trust me, you'll be able to work even better!

Hey, hey, Doctor! She's here at Rhodes Island! Ah, her codename should be Dur-nar now. Anyway, she's incredible! I've literally only seen her in recruitment ads before! And she's such a nice lady! She gave me so many snacks, ehehe.
Doctor, I'm way more athletic than most people my age, you know. Let me show you a standing backflip! Watch closely! Hu-ya!
This gun? Oh, it's a gun-type Arts… Uh… What's that term again? Hmm… Right, Arts Unit! I applied for it out of habit after coming here, but honestly? I still prefer my fists over Arts.
I've always known I'm lucky, but seeing the struggles of other Infected here at Rhodes Island… It's really opened my eyes. Doctor, tell me how I can help. I want to be useful.

Huh…? Oh, Doctor! I'm working on a letter to my dad. I've never told you about him? Then let me introduce him! He's the most incredible policeman ever! You've gotta hear all about his awesome stories!

Truth is, my dad's the one who recommended Rhodes Island. When he learned you could treat Oripathy, he was determined to get me here. Being apart from him is tough… I miss him so much. But I understand what matters most to him is seeing me healthy and safe.

You're almost as reliable as my dad, almost! In my book, you're the second most trustworthy person around, hehe! By the way, I've been telling my dad all about you in my letters, and now he's curious to meet you!
Doc—! Ah, Doctor's asleep. Gotta be quiet…
Nice to meet you, Doctor! I'm a new operator, codename Jackie! I used to be an auxiliary police officer in Columbia. Here's hoping we work well together!
Wow… This is even more awesome than what my dad could do!
Eh, am I getting promoted? Wow, that's awesome!
Rhodes Island's opened my eyes to so much… Maybe one day, I'll be just as amazing as my dad! Doctor, I promise I'll keep working hard, and I'm counting on your guidance!
I'm here!
I'll work hard!
Let's do our best!
Mission start!
Doctor, is it my turn?
Warm-up complete.
Leave it to me.
Time to show my skills!
Try a knuckle sandwich!
No trespassing!
Don't underestimate me!
Push it to the limit!
I thought they had us a few times there, but we did it! You're amazing, Doctor!
Doctor, Doctor, did you see how hard I worked!
Doctor, want me to chase after them?
Sorry, Doctor. If only I'd put in more effort…
Oh… It's so big inside!
Ahhhh!
Hi, Doctor!
Arknights.

Doctor, Happy New Year! This New Year, I'll be celebrating right here at Rhodes Island. Hehe, I've already written to dad, explaining how I'm learning to stand on my own, and how Rhodes Island is a place he can trust. Um, I do feel a bit lonely sometimes. But celebrating with my fellow operators makes up for it!
Ah, it's Doctor!

Doctor! Happy birthday! My dad always taught me birthdays are best spent doing something kind for others. So I'm thinking, how about we head to the kitchen? We can help the logistics operators with today's grocery delivery. Hehehe, who knows? We might just stumble upon some exciting surprises!

'Walk a mile in someone else's shoes before extending a helping hand.' Now I get why the Infected I met before didn't want to accept help or even talk much. I've learned a lot at Rhodes Island. When I return to Columbia, all this will help me become a better police officer.
